HomePage.hero_title: Leading Non-Ferrous Metal Scrap Trading in Indonesia
HomePage.hero_description: With over 20 years of industry experience, we are your trusted partner for high-quality metal scrap solutions.
HomePage.about_first_description: Established in 2002 as UD Multi Logam, we have evolved and transformed into PT Ricaleen Persada Jaya, now recognized as a trusted partner for both local and international companies.
HomePage.about_second_description: Today, we stand as a key player in the non-ferrous scrap metal industry, particularly in the supply of used copper and various other scrap metals.
HomePage.about_third_description: Our extensive network of yards and state-of-the-art processing facilities enables rigorous sorting, packing, and quality control. Every material we receive undergoes a thorough inspection to ensure that the products we deliver meet the highest quality standards.
HomePage.usp_extended_title: Your Trusted Partner for Metal Scrap Solutions
HomePage.usp_point_one_description: We offer a hedging program that allows customers to lock in metal scrap prices at a specific value, protecting your business from unexpected market fluctuations. With this, you can plan your budget more effectively and minimize financial risks caused by global metal price volatility.
HomePage.usp_point_two_title: Integrated and Transparent Quality Control System
HomePage.usp_point_two_description:
• High-Quality Standards: Every material undergoes a strict sorting process in accordance with international standards to ensure purity and cleanliness.
  • Accurate Weighing: We use calibrated digital scales to guarantee fairness and accuracy in every transaction.
HomePage.usp_point_three_description:
• Spacious Yard: Storage and processing facilities capable of handling large volumes with strategic logistics access
  • Efficient Packaging:
    • Jumbo Bags: Ensures material safety during long-distance shipments.
    • Pressed Packing: Compaction technology to optimize logistics efficiency.
HomePage.usp_point_four_description:
• National Sourcing: A supplier network spread across Indonesia, ensuring stable and sustainable material supply.
  • International Partnerships: Collaborations with leading manufacturing and trading companies worldwide.
  • Global Logistics: Material delivery to various countries supported by experienced logistics partners, ensuring timely and secure shipments.
